items.title: The 5% Treasury yield has lost its deterrent power, and JPMorgan says the equity market's break threshold may now be 6%
items.summary: Global bond markets have suffered a fresh bout of violent selling, forcing investors to revisit an uncomfortable question: has the 5% yield on the US 10-year Treasury, long treated as a market warning line, lost its deterrent force? JPMorgan analysts point out that structural forces in AI, healthcare and services have greatly weakened the constraint of the traditional rate transmission mechanism, and that the equity market's break threshold may now have risen to the 5.5% to 6% range
